diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_s3_object.cloudformation_template: explicit depends_on of :resource.random_uuid.splunk_input_uuid is redundant — already implied by attribute references

:resource.aws_s3_object.cloudformation_template explicitly lists :resource.random_uuid.splunk_input_uuid in `depends_on`, but that ordering is already implied by attribute references: `key`, `source`, and `source_hash` all interpolate `random_uuid.splunk_input_uuid.result`. The explicit `depends_on` entry is redundant and can be removed. (The other entry, `data.external.splunk_dm_version`, is not referenced by any attribute and remains necessary.)
